**issue #942: deny readers fail closed on an unreadable brain.config.json**

Hardened five deny/exclusion-direction config readers (actor-check.mjs's defaultReadDenyActors; brain-writes-reviewed.mjs's defaultReadBotAllowlist and defaultReadApprovalActors; approve/cli.mjs's defaultReadDenyActors and defaultReadAgentActors) to propagate a brain.config.json read/parse failure instead of swallowing it to []. New shared primitive loadBrainConfigOrThrow(root) in lib/brain-config.mjs distinguishes absent (ENOENT -> {}) from unreadable (throws, naming the path and failure kind), mirroring memory/lib/upstream-records.mjs. actor-check's and brain-writes-reviewed's existing/new tiered catches route the throw to fail at required tiers instead of warn; brain-writes-reviewed's catch is now tier-aware via a locally duplicated resolveTierForFailure (R4: no L5->L6 import edge). approve/cli.mjs wraps its deny-reader call site in try/catch so a malformed config exits 1 with a refusal message instead of a raw stack trace. ALLOW-direction readers are unchanged by design (R1). R2 doctrine draft filed for maintainer promotion at brain-drafts/deny-readers-fail-closed.draft.md. Full npm test green (5267/5267).
